{{Quote|There's these rogue CorSec miscreants lead by a bloke named Xyrias Undea. If they were to suddenly disappear so they can't muscle in on my rackets, I reckon my memory might return.|[[Gwhirrye Baric]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" />}}
'''Xyrias Undea''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rogue CorSec|rogue]] [[Corellian Security Force]] member who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I can't believe you actually took out those rogue CorSec. Okay, I'll tell you what I know.|Gwhirrye Baric, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Xyrias Undea was leading a group of Rogue CorSec criminals in [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]].<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> they harassed [[Gwhirrye Baric]], a small-time thug who ran a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] racket out of a small hospital in Doaba Guerfel. A CorSec agent working for [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] accepted to help Gwhirrye with his problem and killed several Rogue CorSec miscreants, including Xyrias Undea. In return, Gwhirrye Baric agreed with helping the CorSec to investigate the [[Chirq Council]].<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xyrias Undea was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Xyrias Undea was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
